info.title: Zphil.Roz
info.description: roz-mcp is an MCP server that gives C# coding agents the compiler's view of a solution: Roslyn navigation, blast-radius analysis, and conservative verified writes (solution-wide rename, structured edits, signature changes, code fixes). It was A/B-measured per model tier with a published harness and stress-tested against seven open-source codebases.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Roslyn-powered MCP server for C# semantic code navigation and editing.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Configure roz-mcp for a project (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, or Codex CLI).

options.name: --tools
options.description: Tool subset (preset, category key, or comma/semicolon-separated tool names; prefix with - to exclude).

options.name: --client
options.description: Client(s) to configure: claude, cursor, vscode, codex, or 'all'. Comma-separate for multiple.
